notes.title: BIG 2.0 UPDATE HITS FRIDAY
notes.content:
Hello, Steam! It's been a while!

Been working on this update for far too long, and I gotta say, I'm glad it's finally done, and I can't wait to share it with you! Check out the new trailer!

[previewyoutube=AMMJRIRl-FE;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to multiple Quality of Life improvements and bug fixes, this update brings fun new modes and updates old ones, such as Score Attack, which now spawns a stopwatch every few seconds to give you more time on the clock... if you can catch it before it flies away.

As for new modes, we've got a mode where you can watch the AI duke it out, and a team based mode for 3 players which adds an AI partner for the second team. But the feature I'm most excited about is....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29926091/203beaea55a0bc1d632b689a2d9ebb7793bcf05d.png[/img]

That's right! Bedlamball 2.0 has support for Warp World's [url=https://crowdcontrol.live/]Crowd Control Twitch Extension[/url]! What that means is, if you stream the game on Twitch, your viewers can change the rules while you play! It gets pretty ridiculous.

Bedlamball does not currently have matchmaking for online play. I say currently, because if this update does well, I'm not opposed to making it happen in the future. I strongly recommend trying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play Together[/url] to play the game with friends. It's really simple to set up, and honestly works better than anything I could hope to implement directly into the game right now.

For those of you on the fence, the Free Demo has also been updated, and is available on the top of the game's store page. If you like what you've seen or played, buy the game now to save 40% before the update hits on Friday!

I hope everyone's staying safe and healthy.

-Solidplasma

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29926091/eb5b02bfb8b823e455f9bf4f7e963565dae0ce4e.jpg[/img]
